Thanks Jenny — appreciate the PO.

High level proposal (attached spreadsheet):
- Invoice 1 (prepay deposit): due on execution – full committed amount per PO.
- Monthly sweep: automated monthly drawdown against committed balance on the 1st of each month, with a reconciliation statement by the 5th.
- Milestone top-up: if monthly usage exceeds threshold X% for two consecutive months, we trigger a milestone withdrawal on the next billing cycle.
- VAT handling: for US HQ billing we will issue invoices net of VAT; for EU entities we can route through Redwood EU entity if you supply VAT certificate.

Required fields to include on the invoice: PO number, billing address (per PO), remit-to wiring instructions (attached), and VAT registration copy if EU routing desired.

I've attached our draft annual_prepay_plan_v1.xlsx that maps dates, thresholds, and API usage bands to drawdown amounts. Laura and Marissa are looped for ops/finance confirmation.
